verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke has a dedicated 'Brands, trade marks and designs' service page within its IP practice. It explicitly offers clearance and filing (registration) programmes for trade marks, plus brand management, enforcement and anti-counterfeiting strategies, which covers all three elements of the story as a distinct practice. Missing for 10: independent or third-party corroboration (e.g., rankings or case studies) of the trademark practice, and explicit detail on the team's composition or size.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm handles trademark clearance, registration, and brand enforcement, documented as its own practice or team

citations.quote: We'll provide commercially focused solutions for brand management, exploitation and enforcement wherever you operate
conducting clearance and filing programmes for trade marks and designs
